messages.subject: mean spectra as dataframe
parts:
Hello everyone,
I'm a masterstudent working with MSI-data. The hole MSI-data analysis and the R-enviroment is rather new to me. I somehow learned to work with Cardinal MSI at least I can move on with the manuals. But I need to extract the mean spectra of a chosen ROI to a seperated data frame. I know how to plot the mean spectra, but how I can extract the data? Perhaps it's useful to mention, that my imzML-datasets are all processed.

messages.author: fa51e47cdd090afc
messages.subject: Re: mean spectra as dataframe
parts:
Hi Merve,
hope this piece of code can help you:

myfun <- function(x) c(mean(x))
dataset_df <-featureApply(dataset,.fun=myfun)
write.csv(dataset_df, file="dataset.csv")

Thank you Eduardo, I've figured out that I don't even need the first line.
dataMean <- featureApply(data, mean)
has worked as well. But your advice gave me the main idea and was a great help.
